prompt: Turn the uploaded photo into a vertical 4:5 mixed media memory card, strictly 50/50 split top and bottom. Upper part: the original photo remains completely unchanged, all the subject, composition, light, color and details are kept, only a layer of fine film grain is added. Lower part: warm white handmade paper, with visible fibers, with a soft irregular color spot sampled from the photo. Only redraw the subject into a minimalist dark crayon sketch, with loose lines, not pursuing perfection, with a bit of Risograph print graininess. Write another short handwritten English sentence that fits the mood of the photo. Style: quiet, nostalgic, Morandi tones, tactile, elegant, ample white space. Avoid: redundant elements, clutter, borders, stickers, logos, glossy effects, cartoon or vector styles, and any modifications to the original photo.
